# Captured text for item walleye-modem-net-port-ipa-node (read 2026-11-27): the sources of the ipa node's values in dt/msm8998-google-walleye-modem.dts. Each block names its source; none is edited. Both trees are GPL-2.0.
# ---- A: Google's wahoo kernel, https://android.googlesource.com/kernel/msm branch android-msm-wahoo-4.4-android11, arch/arm/boot/dts/qcom/msm8998.dtsi lines 1165-1179 (ipa_hw: base, interrupts, IPA v3.1)
	ipa_hw: qcom,ipa@01e00000 {
		compatible = "qcom,ipa";
		reg = <0x01e00000 0x34000>,
			<0x01e84000 0x31fff>,
			<0x01e04000 0x2c000>;
		reg-names = "ipa-base", "bam-base", "gsi-base";
		interrupts =
			<0 333 0>,
			<0 432 0>,
			<0 432 0>;
		interrupt-names = "ipa-irq", "bam-irq", "gsi-irq";
		qcom,ipa-hw-ver = <11>; /* IPA core version = IPAv3.1 */
		qcom,ipa-hw-mode = <0>; /* IPA hw type = Normal */
		qcom,ee = <0>;
		qcom,use-gsi;
# ---- A2: the same file, lines 1182-1183 (the clock)
		clocks = <&clock_gcc clk_ipa_clk>;
# ---- A3: the same file, lines 1295-1321 (the three IPA SMMU context banks)
		qcom,smp2pgpio_map_ipa_1_out {
			compatible = "qcom,smp2pgpio-map-ipa-1-out";
			gpios = <&smp2pgpio_ipa_1_out 0 0>;
		};

		qcom,smp2pgpio_map_ipa_1_in {
			compatible = "qcom,smp2pgpio-map-ipa-1-in";
			gpios = <&smp2pgpio_ipa_1_in 0 0>;
		};

		ipa_smmu_ap: ipa_smmu_ap {
			compatible = "qcom,ipa-smmu-ap-cb";
			iommus = <&anoc2_smmu 0x18e0>;
			qcom,iova-mapping = <0x10000000 0x40000000>;
		};

		ipa_smmu_wlan: ipa_smmu_wlan {
			compatible = "qcom,ipa-smmu-wlan-cb";
			iommus = <&anoc2_smmu 0x18e1>;
		};

		ipa_smmu_uc: ipa_smmu_uc {
			compatible = "qcom,ipa-smmu-uc-cb";
			iommus = <&anoc2_smmu 0x18e2>;
			qcom,iova-mapping = <0x40000000 0x20000000>;
		};
	};
# ---- A4: the same file, lines 1323-1328 (the IPA firmware's load through Trust Zone: pas-id 0xF, so the AP loads it)
	qcom,ipa_fws@1e08000 {
		compatible = "qcom,pil-tz-generic";
		qcom,pas-id = <0xF>;
		qcom,firmware-name = "ipa_fws";
	};

# ---- B: the msm8998-mainline fork https://gitlab.com/msm8998-mainline/linux branch mainline/6.1, arch/arm64/boot/dts/qcom/msm8998.dtsi lines 856-866 (smp2p ipa entries) and 1716-1755 (the ipa node)
		ipa_smp2p_out: ipa-ap-to-modem {
			qcom,entry-name = "ipa";
			#qcom,smem-state-cells = <1>;
		};

		ipa_smp2p_in: ipa-modem-to-ap {
			qcom,entry-name = "ipa";
			interrupt-controller;
			#interrupt-cells = <2>;
		};
	};
		ipa: ipa@1e40000 {
			compatible = "qcom,msm8998-ipa";

			iommus = <&anoc2_smmu 0x18e0 0x0>,
				 <&anoc2_smmu 0x18e2 0x0>;
			reg = <0x1e40000 0x7000>,
			      <0x1e47000 0x2000>,
			      <0x1e04000 0x2c000>;
			reg-names = "ipa-reg",
				    "ipa-shared",
				    "gsi";

			interrupts-extended = <&intc GIC_SPI 333 IRQ_TYPE_EDGE_RISING>,
					      <&intc GIC_SPI 432 IRQ_TYPE_LEVEL_HIGH>,
					      <&ipa_smp2p_in 0 IRQ_TYPE_EDGE_RISING>,
					      <&ipa_smp2p_in 1 IRQ_TYPE_EDGE_RISING>;
			interrupt-names = "ipa",
					  "gsi",
					  "ipa-clock-query",
					  "ipa-setup-ready";

			clocks = <&rpmcc RPM_SMD_IPA_CLK>;
			clock-names = "core";

/* Elder's proposed interconnects:
			<&aggre2_noc MASTER_IPA 0 &mem_noc SLAVE_EBI1 0>,
			<&aggre2_noc MASTER_IPA 0 &system_noc SLAVE_IMEM 0>,
			<&gladiator_noc MASTER_APPSS_PROC 0 &config_noc SLAVE_IPA_CFG 0>
*/
			interconnects = <&a2noc MASTER_IPA &bimc SLAVE_EBI>,
					<&a2noc MASTER_IPA &snoc SLAVE_IMEM>,
					<&gnoc MASTER_APSS_PROC &cnoc SLAVE_IPA>;
			interconnect-names = "memory",
					     "imem",
					     "config";

			qcom,smem-states = <&ipa_smp2p_out 0>,
					   <&ipa_smp2p_out 1>;
			qcom,smem-state-names = "ipa-clock-enabled-valid",
						"ipa-clock-enabled";
# ---- B2: the same fork, arch/arm64/boot/dts/qcom/msm8998-oneplus-common.dtsi lines 349-354 (the OnePlus 5 enables it, the AP loads the firmware)
&ipa {
	status = "okay";

	memory-region = <&ipa_fws_region>; // ipa_fw_mem? ipa_gsi_mem?
	firmware-name = "qcom/msm8998/oneplus/ipa_fws.mbn";
};
# ---- C: kernel.org v7.3 (the tag's tree, read 2026-11-27), include/dt-bindings/clock/qcom,rpmcc.h lines 114-115 (the clock numbers)
#define RPM_SMD_IPA_CLK				68
#define RPM_SMD_IPA_A_CLK			69
# ---- C2: Documentation/devicetree/bindings/net/qcom,ipa.yaml, qcom,gsi-loader (what self means) and the required properties
loader:
    enum:
      - self
      - modem
      - skip
    description:
      Indicates how GSI firmware should be loaded.  If the AP loads
      and validates GSI firmware, this property has value "self".
      If the modem does this, this property has value "modem".
      Otherwise, "skip" means GSI firmware loading is not required.

  modem-init:
    deprecated: true
-
